validation.notes: Regression exercises the real submitted project-trust, settings-manager and resource-loader modules linked by .prale-eval/subject.mjs; only in-memory settings storage, extension loading/package resolution and UI/provider boundaries are faked, and asynchronous ordering is deterministic (no timers, randomness or network). Nine scenarios pass on the repair: stored false denial overrides an allow-by-default policy, stored true allow overrides a deny-by-default policy, absent decisions still fall through to the default policy, trusted project defaultModel overrides global while nested compaction merges per key (project reserveTokens 4096 with surviving global keepRecentTokens 2000), withdrawing trust drops project settings and re-trusting restores them, and extension approval, stored allow and interactive 'approve once' all propagate through DefaultResourceLoader.reload so the project extension and project model reach final package/resource resolution (bootstrap resolution remains global-only). A stored denial through reload keeps the project extension out and settings stay untrusted. Mutation checks were run by temporarily restoring each file alone from the baseline commit: project-trust.ts failed with 'a stored denial must override an allow-by-default policy', settings-manager.ts failed with 'project values must win while trusted', and resource-loader.ts failed with 'an approved decision must make project extensions reach final resource resolution'; every failure was a normal uncaught node:assert/strict assertion (no crash, import error or timeout), and the fixed sources were restored byte-for-byte afterwards. Limitation: node_modules is not installed, so the optional TypeScript/vitest toolchain could not be run; validation uses only the Node 24 standard library, creates no persistent test inputs, and leaves no temporary files.
